text_en:
Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) said:

"What is in the womb of a slave woman is gharar (uncertainty), and what is in the wombs of livestock is gharar. And the catch of the diver is gharar, and the catch of the hunter is gharar."

text_ar: سألت زيدة بن على ( رضي الله عنه ) عن قفيز (©) حندلة بقفيز دقيق فال ( رضي الله عنه ) لإ يوز وسألت زيداً بن على ( رضي الله عنهما ) عن . فغيز سحزواة دففيز سو بق © فقال ( رصي الله عاه ) : لا جوز 3 شال نذا سْ على ( رضى الله عنه ) عن : عشرة أرطال حجلد 47 أو أكر بقفيز سمسم ؟ فقال ( رضي الله عنه ) : إن كان في القفيز عشرة أرطال حلا أ 0-6 و أكثر »ء فالبيم فاسد ؟ » وإنِ كان ما فيه من اسل 5 الحل أقل من عشرة أرطل » فالبيع جائر . أو قيمة شاة من الشرار ١‏ ه أم ٠,‏ وه - اذيعا يختلنان هل عملم شن الطناة الكاقدة قد شاه هن كيان نك ثُمانية مكاكيك . والجمع أقفزة » وقفزان » والقفيزن أيضا من الارض عشر الجريب؛:وقفيزن الطحان معروف: ونهي عنه وصورته أن تقول استأجرتك على طحن هذه الحنطة برطل دقيق منها مثلا » وسواء كان ذلك مسع غيره 5 ع وهشى د سن السمسم ك6 أولى لان العشرة الارطال قيمة للعشرة الارطال التي تخرج من السمسم وداخد صاحب العشرة الارطال السمسم بغين قيمة إٍ ه آم 5 ا ؟
text_en: I asked Zayd ibn Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) about a *qafiz* of wheat for a *qafiz* of flour, and he (may Allah be pleased with him) said: It is not permissible. And I asked Zayd ibn Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) about a *qafiz* of wheat for a *qafiz* of barley, and he (may Allah be pleased with him) said: It is not permissible. And I asked Zayd ibn Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) about ten *artal* of wheat for a *qafiz* of sesame? He (may Allah be pleased with him) said: If there are ten *artal* of wheat or more in the *qafiz*, then the sale is invalid. But if the amount of wheat in it is less than ten *artal*, then the sale is permissible.

text_ar: ( حدثي )») زيد ن عل عن أديه عن جده عن علي رضي الله عنهم أنه سكل عن رجل له مماو كت'ن أنحدان فوطىء أحدهو| ) 9 أراد أن يدلأ الأحرى. ؟ فقال ( رضي الله عنه ).: ايس له أن يملأ الأخرى حى مم اللي وطثها أو يزوجها » سألت زيداً بن علي ( رضي الله عنه ) عن الأمة إذا كانت لا نحيض بكم يستبرئها ؟ فقال ( رضي الله عنه )' دشهر قلت : إإله كان ماكدها مويه ف مير أنث '6 3 وفعت قُ سهمة من المغنم كله سواء قال رضي الله عنه : نعم . 0 الاستبراع اختبار الامة بحيضة 'قيل الوطء وهو طلب البراءة دن حمل ريما يكون معها ٠‏ "2
text_en:
Zayd ibn Ali, on the authority of his father, from his grandfather, from Ali, may Allah be pleased with them, reported that he was asked about a man who had two female slaves, and he had intercourse with one of them. Then he wanted to have intercourse with the other. Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, said: He is not allowed to have intercourse with the other until the one he had intercourse with has completed her `iddah, or he marries her.

I asked Zayd ibn Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, about a female slave who does not menstruate, how long should her `iddah be? He, may Allah be pleased with him, said: One month.

I said: If she was a female slave and she was not menstruating, and she fell into his share of the spoils of war, is it permissible for him to have intercourse with her? He, may Allah be pleased with him, said: Yes.

Istibra’ is the testing of a female slave with one menstruation before intercourse, and it is seeking to ensure she is not pregnant, as she might be.

text_ar: ( حدثي ) زيد بن علي عن أبيه عن جده عن علي رضي الله عنهم قال : قال رسول الله ام : « ثلاثة لا يكلمهم الله تعالى » ولا ينظر إليهم يوم القيامة » ولا يزكيهم ٠»‏ وهم عذاب ألم . رجل بايم إماماً إن أعطاه شيئاً من الدنيا » وفى له © وإن لم يعطه لم يعن له ء ورجل له ماء على ظهر الاريق يمنئعه سابلة © الطريق » ورجل داف بعد العصر »© لتد على : في سلعته كذا و كذا فأخذها الاخر مصدقا للذي قال » وهو كاذ ( ياب من ملك ذ! رحم محسرم
text_en: Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali, may Allah be pleased with them, said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: "There are three whom Allah the Almighty will not speak to, nor look at on the Day of Resurrection, nor purify them, and for them is a painful torment: A man who pledges allegiance to an Imam: if he gives him something from this world, he fulfills his pledge to him, but if he does not give him, he does not fulfill his pledge to him. And a man who has water on the back of a road and withholds it from travelers. And a man who sells after Asr, swearing by Allah that his merchandise is such and such, and the other person takes it, believing what he said, while he is a liar."

text_ar: ( <دثي ) زيد بن علي عن أبيه عن جده عن على رضي الله عنهم قال : : قال رسول الله ع 0 بم حاضر لياد © دعوا رخ د © الناس "2 0 أيله علض سم من بعض ) ومانا رسول الله يللم عن دلقي الر كبان 9) هغت المرأة تبغى بغاء الكسر اذا زنت فهي بغي | ه نهاية ٠‏ )59١‏ في المنهاج الجحلى وآجر كل ماء عسيب 2 وهي الفحول 2 وفي ذنسحة ماء عسب قال ابن قتيبة : عسب الفحل الكراء الذي يؤخذ على ضرابه اذا اكترى لذلك 2 وقال يعضهم : العسب هى الضراب نقسه 2 فسمى الكراء عليه عسييا به | ها ٠‏ التحاط ‏ القن قن لدان رو انقرفي عابو الكاق" لقم عالكائية ”و بو امتون عنه أن يأتي البدوي اليلدة » ومعه قوت دبغى التسارع الى بديعه رخيصا قفيقول له الحضرى اتركه عندي لاغالي في بيعه ؛ فهذا الصتع محرم لما ذيه من الاضرار ملحو والبيع اذا جرى مع المغالاة منعقد . وهذا اذا كانت السلعة مما تعم الحاجة اليها كالاقوات + فان كانت لا تعم أى كثر القوت واستغنى عنه ففي التحريم تردد ويعول في أحدهما على عموم ظاهر النهي , وحسم باب الضرر ٠»‏ وفي الثاني على معنى الضرورة , وزواله . وقد جاء عن ابن عياس رضي الله عنه انه سل عن معنى لا يبع حاضر لباد ؟ قال : لا يكون له سمسارا اه نهاية ٠‏ 5686
text_en:
Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali, may Allah be pleased with them, who said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: "Let no resident sell for a Bedouin."

And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, forbade the earnings of a stallion.

And the earnings of a female prostitute. If she commits adultery, she is a prostitute.

End. 591. In al-Minhaj: And the earnings of every stallion. And they are the male animals. And in a copy: the earnings of a stallion. Ibn Qutaybah said: The earnings of a stallion are the fee taken for its mating if it is hired for that. And some said: The earnings are the mating itself. So the fee for it is called earnings.

End. 592. The meaning of "Let no resident sell for a Bedouin" is that the Bedouin comes to the town with his provisions, seeking to sell them cheaply. Then the resident says to him, "Leave it with me, I will sell it at a higher price." This action is forbidden due to the harm it causes. However, if the sale takes place with an inflated price, it is still valid. This applies if the commodity is something that is widely needed, like provisions. But if it is not widely needed, meaning there is an abundance of provisions and one can do without it, then there is hesitation regarding its prohibition. In one case, it relies on the general apparent prohibition and closing the door to harm. In the second case, it relies on the meaning of necessity and its removal. It has been narrated from Ibn Abbas, may Allah be pleased with him, that he was asked about the meaning of "Let no resident sell for a Bedouin?" He said: "He should not be his broker." End. 593.

text_ar: ( حدثي ) زيد بن على عن أديه عن جده عن علي ( رضي الله سجس انا رصي العيد ١‏ ه من ع * 1 ؟ عنئة ) قال : أسلت 2 طعام إل أجل ل جيل عند صاحيه ذلاتث 0 فمال : جل مي غير ه دسعر رو مةه لم يكن له أن رأخحل إلا العام للف 7 اسلفته فيه 6 أو 0 ماله © وآأيس له أن نحل نوعآ من الدزعام غير ذلاتك الذوع ١‏ حدثي ) زيك بن علي عن أذيه عن جده عن علي ( رصي الله عنمهم ( قال 4 ل بأس أن حون بعص رأسسمالاك 3 وبعضص رأس سلالمك و لا تأخخل يا من غير ساماث .
chapter: باب العيد الماذون له في التجارة
text_en:
Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them all), said: "If you lend food for a specified term to a person, and he has that food with him, then he may not return anything other than the food for which you lent it to him, or its equivalent in money. And he may not return a type of food other than that type."

Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them all), said: "There is no harm in some of your capital being in cash and some of your capital being in goods, but do not take from other than your capital."

text_ar: ( حدثني ) زيد بن على عن أبيه عن جده » عن على رضي الله عنهم : أنه كان يكره أن تزرع الأرض سبعر هأ 4 وكان ار نخصس 8 اأشثر خية 9 ٠‏ , خيسر يوزن جعقر مدينة على ثمائية يرب من المدينة الى جهة الشام‎ )١( ٠ سميت باسم رجل من العماليق نزل بها | هه من شرح البهجة‎ ه نهاية‎ ١ (؟) تلقيح النخل وضع طلع الذكر في طلع الانقى أول ما دنشق‎ يقال لقحى! تخلهم والقحى نخلهم وقد لقحت النخل » ويقال في النخلة الواحدة لقحت بالتخقيف أ ه صحاح ٠.‏ (“) أزيال الغثم وتحوها اه ٠‏ 1ه ؟ كعوبانن الشركة 5 « حدثني ) زيد بن علي عن أبيه عن جده عن علي « رضي الله عنهم) أن رجلين كانا شريكين على عهد رسول الله علي » فكان أحدهما مواضباً على السوق والتتجارة؛و كان الآخر مواضباً عل المسجد والصلاة97) خلف رسول الله يلكي » فلما كان عند قسمة الربح قال المواضب عل السوق : فضلنى فإنىي كنت مواضباً عإ التجارة وأنت كنت تواضشا عل اللبره ودنطاء إل روف الله علق 'افنكارة اذيك اند فقال النبي مَِلثم : الذي كان يواضب عل السوق إبما كنت ترزق ممواضية صاحرك على المسجد
text_en:
Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them all): He disliked that the land be sown with seven (types of seeds). He permitted the pollination of palm trees.

Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them all): Two men were partners during the time of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him). One of them was diligent in the market and trade, while the other was diligent in the mosque and prayer behind the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him). When it came time to divide the profit, the one diligent in the market said: "Favor me, for I was diligent in trade, and you were diligent in prayer." They referred their dispute to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him). The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "The one who was diligent in the market, you were only sustained by the diligence of your companion in the mosque."

text_ar: )0 حدثي 4 زيك بن علل عن انيه عن جدكه عن علي (رضي ألله عنهم ) قال لو د مر الك كان الى طاو 4 11101 عار را فيكم قار ها 000 م لشر يكين لم يتخاو: ور 0 قرفعءثت البر كة مذمأ 0 الشركة بقتح وسكون وحكي فتح فكسور و فتسح فسكون وقد . تحدذدف هاوّها فتصدر مشتذركة بيذهاأ وبين التخصيب 5 وهي لغة الاختلاط وشرعا: ثبوت الحق ؛ ولى قهرا شايعا في الشيء لاكثر من واحد » وعقد يقتضي ذلك كالشر | ه تحفة 8 5 رمك قزاقن ها الشدياة الاعتكنا ل لاض الكاقم غذى كن انحسافة بنتو اد قيل بوجويها + أى بعدمه كما هى الحق ٠‏ 59 رواه أدو داود وحنبحة الحاكم ومعناه أن الله معهما أي في الحفظ #6 سي كن « حدثى ) زيد بن على عن أديه عن جده عن على ١‏ رضى الله عنه ) في : الشريكين قال : اربح على ما اصالحا عليه والوضيعة على قدر رووس أموالهما » وقال زيد بن على ( رضي الله عنه ) : الشركة شر كتان » شركة عنانف » وشركة مفاوضة . فالعنان الشريكان في نوع من التجارة خاصة ٠:‏ وامماو ضة الويكان 2 كل قأيل و كثير
text_en:
Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them) said: If the two partners were to be honest and sincere, they would not have been separated. The blessing would have been removed from them. Partnership (sharika) is with a fatha and sukun, and it is narrated with a fatha then kasra, and a fatha then sukun. Its waw can be omitted, so it becomes musharaka between them and the fertility. Linguistically, it means mixing. Legally, it is the establishment of a right, or a shared right in something for more than one person, and a contract that necessitates that, like a partnership. This is a masterpiece. Its meaning is that Allah is with them, meaning in preservation.

Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) regarding two partners, said: The profit is according to what they agreed upon, and the loss is according to the amount of their capital. Zayd ibn Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) said: Partnership is of two types: partnership of 'inan and partnership of mufawada. The 'inan is when two partners are in a specific type of trade. The mufawada is when two partners are in all little and much.

text_ar: ( حدثي ) زيد بن علي عن أبيه عن جده عن علي ( رضي الله عنهم) قال 8 00 خرف 1 لغيره 3 أو أكل اا لغيره 5 أ 00 عودآً 5 5 8 . ٠. 85 غير ه صن
text_en: Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them) said: "Whoever eats from a garden that is not his, or eats from a date palm that is not his, or eats from a tree that is not his, then there is nothing upon him."

text_ar: 0 ددني ع( ريدن علي عن أده عن داه عن علي ١‏ ردي الله عدم أذ4 لعل عل )00 الو فى الع درهمآ إل كان سواء دك عن عسير ثللاثة ايام ٠‏ وإكث جاء من دون ذلك رضخ له
text_en: Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) who said: If a man comes to you with a dirham, it is the same as if he came to you with ten dirhams. And if he comes to you with less than that, then give him something.

text_ar: ) حدثي ) ز دك . ددعل لى عن أديه عن جده عن علي لى ( رض ي الله عنهم‎ ١ . ان رعولة كفل 0 فسن راجلل فحاسه وى ا دك‎ لاه الجعل الاسم بالضم والمصدر بامفتح دقال : جعلت إك كذا جعلا وجعلا‎ ى الاشيء فعلا أى قولا | ه ذهاية في التحقة الجعالة‎ بتذليث الجيم فالجعل والجعيلة لغة ها يجعله الانسان لغيره على شديء‎ دثلا ذين رأس من | لخنم | له د تحفةه 9 وهشى الاحجرد عل 50 قشت لأسا ددع ١0/‏
text_en:
Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them) reported:

A lost camel was found, so a man came and claimed it. He said: "I will give a reward (ju'ala) for it."

text_ar: ل حدثى ) زنك يرح عل عن أديه عن جده عن على ر ضى الله عدهم قال : لا ضمان على مستعير ولا مسةتودع إلا أن مخالف » ولا ضمان من شارك في اربح ٠‏ وللمستودع أن يودع اوديعة اءرأته وولده وعيده واونرة 0 قال ادق محا إل أظن هلا اكلام الأخير 9 من" كلام زيد بن على ٠.‏ ( رضي الله عنه ) وليس هو عن علي رضي الله عنه قال (4) زبد سن عي 2 ر ضي الله عنه ) 0 ينتفع اوموق من اأرهن بشيء » فان ولد الرهن كان اولد مع الرهن رهناً مع المرهن » وو كذلاك لتسليم الخفس في أي عمل أراد المستاجر أ له مشتهاج أهل البيت رضي الله عنهم رواه في شرح الابانة 0 قد ذبت أنه دستحفظ ماله مع هؤلاء فله أن يحفظ فل الوددعة معهم ٠‏ )5١‏ هنا ع ا ا ا ا و بفضل الدين على القيمة قبل باب العارية والوديعة بعد باب الرهن ٠‏ . ”09 الثمرة هى رهن من اانخل » ولا يجوز اارهن إلا مقبوضا لأن الله عز وجل يقول فرهان مقبوضة
text_en:
Zayd ibn Ali narrated to us from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) who said: "There is no guarantee upon a borrower or a trustee unless he acts contrary to the agreement. And there is no guarantee for one who shares in profits." And the trustee may entrust the deposit to his wife, his child, his slave, and his relatives. Al-Dhahabi said: "I think this last statement is from the words of Zayd ibn Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) and not from Ali (may Allah be pleased with him)."

(4) Zayd ibn Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) said: "The one who takes a pledge may not benefit from the pledge in any way. If the pledge gives birth, the offspring is also a pledge along with the original pledge." And similarly, for handing over the five (fingers) in any work the hirer desires for him. This is desired by the People of the House (Ahl al-Bayt) (may Allah be pleased with them). He narrated it in Sharh al-Ibanah. "I have established that he entrusts his wealth with these people, so he may keep the deposit with them."

(5) This is a chapter on the pledge, and it is before the chapter on borrowing and deposits, after the chapter on pledges.

(6) The fruit is a pledge from the palm trees, and a pledge is not permissible unless it is taken possession of, because Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, says: "And pledges taken possession of."

text_ar: ( حادثى ) زيك بن علي عن أبيه عن جده عن علي ) ر ضي الله عذهم ) مرضي لمعيه “كال : - ا وكل الخصوصومة إلى عيك الله سس عدر م فضى له شل 5 وهأ فضى عاية فعلي 35 و كاك قبل ذلات : واكل الخصومة 97 ع 5 0ه ب إلى عقيل 0 اي طالب حدى دوقي 0 )١(‏ لاتواء عليه أي لا ضياع . ولا خسارة . وهى من التواء والهلاك (؟) الضدمير الذي في توفي عائد الى أمير المؤمنين رضي الله عنه أي أنه استمر توكيله لعيد الله بن جعفر حتى توفي بعد أن كان . وكل عقيل ابن أبي طالب رحمه الله 2 وقوله وكان قبل ذلك الخ جملة معترضة الخ ا هاام ٠‏ مه ؟”
text_en: Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them) who said: "I used to entrust all disputes to Abdullah ibn Ja'far. Whatever he judged in favor of, it was so. And whatever he judged against, it was so. And before that, I used to entrust all disputes to Aqil ibn Abi Talib."

text_ar: )0 حدثي ) زيك من علي عن أثيه عن جذه عن عل ١‏ ر ضي ألله عنهم ) أنه قال ني الحوالة لاتواء "© على مسام إذا أفلس المحتال رج صاحب الحق على الذييع أحاله م و * . (١‏ حدثى ) زيد بن على عن أبيه عن جده عن على ( 8 رجل له على وجل حبس * فكفل أه رجل امال قال أيه 8 بأخحذهما
text_en:
(0) Zayd ibn Ali narrated from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them) that he said concerning a transfer of debt: "There is no liability if the transferee becomes bankrupt. The owner of the right returns to the one who transferred the debt."

(1) Zayd ibn Ali narrated from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them) that he said concerning a man who had a debt owed to him by another man who was imprisoned, and a man guaranteed him the money: "He takes both of them."

text_ar: ( حدثبي ) زيك بن علي عن أريه صن جده عن علي رضي الله عنهم) م بات 0 1 0 , ا اذكه كان ناهر شرئكا بالحخاوسس قن لانيو الاعظم 1 وكأل يعدي شو عا على القضاء رزقا 0 من ذبت مال المسلوحن 1 5 2 عر ) 5 ( ز دك ب 5 عون أله عن جله عن ع 0 دق الله عذج ) كان : األريئة العادلة اولمى من اليمين الهاجرة وا اا لي نكا سن ع رصي الله عنهما عن تنسير ذلاك قال : هو الرجل يحلف على حق الرجل : (<دثي) زيد با علي عن أبيه عن جده عن علي ( رضي الله عنم 4 قال : نخمسة أشياء إلى الإمام : صلاة الممعة وااعيددن . وأخحذ الصدقات 35 ' 0 . 7
text_en:
Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them) said: "The Imam is the one who is a partner in the five things. He is the one who is the greatest judge. And he does not appoint a judge over the provisions from the wealth of the Muslims."

Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them) said: "The just oath is more severe than the false oath." And when he was asked about the interpretation of that, he said: "It is a man who swears an oath over the right of another man."

Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them) said: "Five things belong to the Imam: the Friday salah, the two Eids, and the collection of sadaqat."

text_ar: ( حدثى ) زيد بن عل عن أديه عن جده عن علي ( رضي الله عنههم )0 جد في العوف: اتنا 'مكون. بالسكين فعدل. هته لعلف أن الذي أراف عة نا دخاف علده من هلاك دينه دون هلاك بدنه ١‏ والثاني : أن الذبح الذي تقع نيا برابطة الدبيحة »«وخلاصتها كن 'الالم'انما مكون. بالسكين :قاذ ذبح بغير السكين كان ذبحه تعذيبا له فضرب به المثل ليكون أبلغ في الحذن < واكيه فى التوفى.عنة الى )١(‏ قوله وأنت غضبان رواه الجماعة بلفظ لا يقضي حاكم بدن اثنين وهو غضيان ٠‏ 2 حددي ا علي عن ابيه عن جده عن علي ( رصي الله عنهم ( اذ ديس الماضى 6 8 دن 2 م مان | إفلاسةه 5 وداءجةه مو إخرجه حبى يستفيد مالا . ثم يقول إذا استفدت مالا فاقسمه بين غرمائك قال *
text_en:
Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them) said:

He found in al-Awf: "Bring a knife." So he straightened it for al-Awf. The one who fears for his religion from its destruction, not the destruction of his body. The second is that the slaughter that occurs with the bond of the slaughtered animal, and its essence is that the pain is only with a knife. If he slaughters with something other than a knife, his slaughter is torture for it. So he struck it as an example to be more eloquent in warning. And he mentioned in al-Tawfiq from him (1) His saying: "And you are angry." The group narrated it with the wording: "No judge should judge between two while he is angry."

Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them) said:

When a bankrupt person is brought, he is imprisoned until he benefits from wealth. Then he says: "If you benefit from wealth, divide it among your creditors." He said:

text_ar: 1 حدثبي ) زيك سن علي عن أبيه عن جده عن علي ) ركي الله عنهم 4 قال : إذا ربجم الشاهد ضمن . 03 يه صبون )١(‏ بالظاء المتهم . وبالضاد البخيل : ومنه القراءتان في قوله تعالى : «دوما هى على الغيب يضنين » قال الامام محمد بن المطهر رضي الله عنه قلت : والمراد بالظنين الذي هو كثير التظنن , هل كان هذا أى لم يكن لانه رضى الله عنه قد ذكر المتهم فلا يحمل الظنين على المتهم 1ه من المنهاج . ومن شهادة المتهم أن يشهد على خصمه , فانه لا يقبل قد رويئا عن النبي صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم أنه قال : لا تقبل شهادة خصم ولا ظنين . ولا ذي أحنة ١‏ ه منهاج » ومن التهمة شهادة الوالد لولده اهاج ٠‏ (ب#ب)وه ضدذين البخيل وظنين المتشكك ٠‏ 00 , ظ “تي ) زيد بن على عن أبيه عن جاءه عن علي ( رضي الله عنهم) لا نحوز شهادة ولك أوالده . | . روت ولا وائد ليلده إلا الحسن و الله ا شهاك مأ الحسن 0 فإ دادره 5
text_en:
Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them) said: If a witness is accused (of lying), his testimony is not accepted.

(The word "ẓanīn" (ظنين) with a ẓāʾ means "accused." With a ḍād, it means "stingy." From this are the two readings in His saying, the Exalted: "And he is not stingy with the unseen." Imam Muhammad ibn al-Mutahhar (may Allah be pleased with him) said: "I say: And what is meant by 'ẓanīn' is one who is very suspicious, was this so, or was it not? Because he (may Allah be pleased with him) already mentioned the accused, so 'ẓanīn' should not be interpreted as 'accused.'" End of Minḥāj. And among the accusations against a witness is that he testifies against his opponent, for his testimony is not accepted. It has been narrated from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) that he said: "The testimony of an opponent, nor an accused, nor one with malice is accepted." End of Minḥāj. And among the accusations is the testimony of a parent for his child. End of Minḥāj. (The word "ẓanīn" (ظنين) means stingy, and "ẓanīn" (ظنين) means doubtful.)

Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them) said: The testimony of a child for his parent, or a parent for his child, is not permissible, except for al-Hasan and al-Husayn (may Allah be pleased with them), for their testimony is accepted for their father.

text_en: Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) that he ruled by the testimony of one woman. She was the guardian of her children and their property, and he made her testimony valid and made them inherit by her testimony.

2. Zayd ibn Ali narrated from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali, may Allah be pleased with them, that he named a son Nafi'. Then it occurred to him, so he changed his name and called him 'Awn. And he used to say:

"Have you not seen me, how I was, how I was?
The prayers of Nafi' are not accepted."

Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them) said: Regarding a beast in the hand of a man, which two men claim, and each of them has two witnesses, and the other has three witnesses. He said: It is divided among five owners. Two-fifths for the two, and three-fifths for the three.

(He said: The noble hadith indicates that an increase in reliable witnesses has an effect, and it is possible that the beast is in the hands of both of them. The practice in books of fiqh is that the two claims cancel each other out. And it refers to preference. Abu Dawud, Al-Hakim, and Al-Bayhaqi narrated from Abu Musa that two men claimed a camel during the time of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, so each of them sent a witness.)

Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) said: Two men drowned a man, and three men witnessed that they drowned him. Then the Commander of the Believers Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) ruled that the blood money is on the two who drowned him, and the three witnesses are innocent.

text_ar: ( حدثي ) زيد بن علي عن أبيه عن جده عن علي ( رضي الله عنهم) أن مسلمأ قتل خنزيراً انصراني » فضمته على ( رضى الله عنه ) قيمته ؤقالة © انما أعطينا هم الذمة على أن يركوا يستحالون في دينهم ما
text_en: Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them) reported that a Muslim killed a Christian's pig. Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) made him pay its value and said: "We only granted them protection on the condition that they be left to practice their religion as they see fit."

text_ar: حدثي زيد بن علي عن أنه عن جده صن علي ر ضي الله عنه قال : وال سول الله لتر ١‏ ااه يكون هر أقل هن عشرة دراهم ليس نكاح أولاهل مثل هر اله خى )
text_en: Zayd ibn Ali narrated from his father, from his grandfather, may Allah be pleased with him, who said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: "There is no marriage with a dowry less than ten dirhams."

text_en: Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them) said: "There is no marriage except with a guardian and two witnesses. It is not with a dirham or two dirhams, nor for a day or two days. This is prostitution. And there is no condition in marriage."

text_ar: ( حدثئي) زيد بن علي عن أبيه عن جده عن علي ( رضي الله عنهم) أنه قال : دباغ الإهاب ظهوره وإن كان ميتة . « حدثي ) زيد بن على عن أبيه عن جده عن علي ١‏ رضي الله عنهم) أنه أخيل شاهد الزور قعورره ؛ وطاف ره قُ سحيهة وشّهره © وممبى أن يرفع موجب الاقرار أن التيذير بالاقوال واقع ؛ كما يقع بغيره واذ! حنث . كفر بالصوم , لانه ممنوع من التصرف فاشيه المعدم أه منهاج ٠‏ ينس , حدثي ) زيد بن علي عن أبيه عن -جده عن علي ( رضي الله عنهم) أنه قال . لا جوز شهادة اأنساء ّ نكاح ولا طلاق 5 ولا سول هد ولا قصاص ) حدنى ) زبك إن على عن أديه عن بجده عن علي 0 رصي الله عنهم ( في : الرجل يطلق امرأته فيس:تافان ني متاع البيت فقضى علي ( رضي الله عنه ) في ذلك أن ما كان يكون لارجال . فهو للرجل . وما كان يكون لانساء . فهو للنساء . وما كان يكون للنساء . والرجال فهو بينه«ا نه يلس 3 )00
text_en:
Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them) that he said: The tanning of the hide is its purification, even if it is from a carcass.

Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them) that he said: The false witness is disgraced, and his shame is spread in his tribe, and he is exposed. And it is permissible to raise the obligation of confession, that warning by words occurs, just as it occurs by other means. And if he breaks an oath, he expiates by fasting, because he is prevented from disposing, so he resembles the destitute. This is from Minhaj.

Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them) that he said: The testimony of women is not permissible in marriage, nor in divorce, nor in hudud (prescribed punishments), nor in qisas (retaliation).

Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them) regarding a man who divorces his wife, and they dispute over the household furnishings. Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) ruled in this matter that whatever belongs to men, it is for the man. And whatever belongs to women, it is for the women. And whatever belongs to both women and men, it is divided between them.

text_ar: ( حدثي ) زيد بن علي عن أبيه عن جده عن علي رضي الله عاهم قال : قال رسول الله : إذا نظر العبد إلى وجه زوجه . ونظارت إليه نظر الله إإليهما نظر رحمة . فإذا أخذ بكمها. وأخحذدت يكفه تتساقات ذلوعيما من خلال أصابعهما فإذا فاه سيت يها" اللففكة: عن الارهي الل غنان اماف نو كانت كل لذة وكل شهوة حسئات كأمثال الخبال فإذا حملت كان ها أجر د يا أيها الذين آمذوا اذا نكحدم المؤمنات . ثم طلقتموهن من قبل أن تصمسدى شم 4 اء والثاني بسعذى الوطيء قال تعالى ا ذفان طلقها فلا تحل له دن يعد حدى ددم زوجا غدرد الثالت يعتى الحكم قال تعالى 0 حدى اتا دلغوا النكاح ١‏ الرايع بمعتى المهر قال تعالى :»ا وليستعقف إلا زاذية 4 * المصلى الصاتم القائم المجاهد ني سبيل الله » فإذا وضعت لم تعام نفس م أخفى هم من رة أعين ا( قال : قال رسول الله ملت : « خير النساء الواود الودود التي إذا نظارت إليهاأ مدر ثلث 95 وإدا عيت عذها ممظتاك »؛
chapter: باب فضل النكاح وما جاء في ذلك
text_en:
Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali, may Allah be pleased with them, who said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: "When a servant looks at the face of his wife, and she looks at him, Allah looks at them with a gaze of mercy. And when he takes her hand, and she takes his hand, their sins fall away through their fingers. And when he speaks to her, it is as if he has given a thousand dirhams in charity. And if she becomes pregnant, she has the reward of one who fasts, prays, stands in prayer, and strives in the way of Allah. And when she gives birth, no soul knows what has been hidden for them of the delight of their eyes."

He said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: "The best of women is the loving, fertile one, who, when you look at her, she pleases you, and when you are absent from her, she protects your honor."

text_ar: ) حدثبي ) زيدك بن علي عن ابيه عن جده عن علي (ر صي الله عنهم ) أنه سأل عثمان بن عفان أن جر 7" على عبدالله بن جعفر رضي الله عنهما : وذلك أنه بلغه أنه اشترى 47 شيئاً فخبن فية بأمر مفرط . -ج- 29 01) 5) فيه أنه أتى في امرآة باعت هي وابنها خادما لزوجها » فقدم الزوج , وقد ولدت الجارية فقضى للزوج بالجارية » وولدها . وحيس المرأة وابنها يعني بدين المشترى قال محمد ين منصور ؛ وهذا أصل من علي رضي الله عنه في كل شيء تشعب من هذا الباب ألا ترى أنه لم يجن بيع العرض على غائب وان كان البائع ممن تجب له النفقة ٠‏ دالوالل الدال. هنا + وهم قظا ع الطريق + ولفظط القاموسى المخيس كمعظم ومحدث السحجن » وسحن يبتاأد ع مي رضى الله عنه . وكان أولا جعله من قصيب وسسماء ناقعا قتقيه اللصصسرص.ى فقال : أما تراني كيسا مكيسا بنيت بعد نافع مخيسا بايا حصينا وأمينا كيسا وفي القاموس : الحجر يثلث المنع كالحجران بالكسر والضم ١‏ ه والذي يرجح أن الكسر فيما أريد يه الحرام أرجح ٠»‏ وهذا الترحجيح مسكوت عنه عند صاحب القاموس ؛ بل ظاهره استواء الاوجه الثلاثة فيه » وهي الحكيو و المتم رالهراء + قيل : شرى أرضا سبخة بستين ألفا فقال عثمان ما يسرني أن تكون لي يه مض
text_en:
Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them), that he asked Uthman ibn Affan to impose a penalty on Abdullah ibn Ja'far (may Allah be pleased with them both), because it reached him that he had bought something and was excessively defrauded in it.

(2901) In it, a woman came who, along with her son, had sold a servant belonging to her husband. The husband then arrived, and the slave-girl had given birth. So he ruled in favor of the husband for the slave-girl and her child, and he imprisoned the woman and her son, meaning for the debt of the purchase.

Muhammad ibn Mansur said: "This is a principle from Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) in everything that branches out from this chapter. Do you not see that he did not permit the sale of an عرض (article) to an absent person, even if the seller was someone for whom maintenance was obligatory?"

Here, they are blocking the road. And the word in Al-Qamus is "al-habs" (imprisonment), like "mu'azzam" and "muhaddath" (imprisoned). And he imprisoned him. Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) was the first to make it from reeds and a ceiling that was permeable, so the thieves would escape. He said: "Do you not see me as a clever, cunning person? I built, after Nafi', a prison with a strong and trustworthy door."

And in Al-Qamus: "Al-hajr" (prohibition/restriction) with three vowels (fatha, kasra, damma) means prevention, like "al-hijran" with kasra and damma. And what is preferred is that the kasra is more appropriate when what is intended is the forbidden. And this preference is unspoken by the author of Al-Qamus; rather, its apparent meaning is the equality of the three forms (al-hajr, al-hijr, al-hujr). It was said: He bought barren land for sixty thousand, so Uthman said: "It would not please me to have it for that price."

text_ar: )0 حدثي ) زنك عن علي عن أديه عن حذده :. عن عم ١‏ رصى ألله عنهم » قال : قال رسول الله ملت : «١‏ تستأمر اديج .يه الفيدها قالوا فإن البكر تستحى قال : إذنبا صماتما 06
text_en: My father, from his father, from Ali, from his father, from Hudhayfah, may Allah be pleased with them, who said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: "Consult women regarding their daughters." They said: "Indeed, a virgin is shy." He said: "Then her silence is her permission."

text_ar: ) حدثي ) زيك سن علي عن أدية عن جده ٠)‏ عن علي 1 رضي الله ٠‏ 2 . 3 ”3 لد 5 5 ل 9( , عنهم » قال : نبى رسول الله يق عن نكاح المتعة "؟ عام خيبر )١(‏ بفتح الصاد واكسرها , ويسمى صدقة يفتح الصاد وضم الدال ٠‏ وقد سكن الدال . وقد يضمان يقال أصدقها 2 ومهرها وأمهرها بمعدذى افد فيل السبداق: ها استحفكة بالتسعية فى: العقن: ». والمون هنا استحق بغير ذلك . ومن أسسمائه العقر والعليقة والاجر : والنحلة والحداء . والطول . وسيمى صداقا لإشعاره يصدق رغبة باذله فى النكاح ١‏ ه من شرم البهجة ٠‏ ْ (؟) وروي عن الامام الشهيد زيد بن على رضي الله عنهما أنه سكل عن المتعة ؟ فقال : المتعة مثل الميتة . والدم ولحم الخنزير ٠.‏ وسثل صلى الله ليه وآله وسلم عنها فقال : رخصة نزل بها القرآن » وحرمها لما نزلت العدة , والمواريث.وهذا اجماع آهل البيت رضي الله عنهما فقيل: سه >
text_en: Yahya ibn Ali narrated from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) forbade temporary marriage (nikah al-mut'ah) on the day of Khaybar.

text_ar: 2 حدثبي ) زيك إن علي عن أديه عن جده عن علي ر ضي الله عنهم قال : قال رسول الله ار 2 كما عيى تزوج دغير إذل موالية فهو زان )
text_en: 2 Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali, may Allah be pleased with them, said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: "Any woman who marries without the permission of her guardian, then her marriage is invalid."

text_ar: )2 حدثى ) زيك بن على عن أديه عن جده عن ط لى ( ر ضري الله ع 5< أذه قال إيا تة روج ألامة 0 على الدرة 8 وود 0 ادرة على الأمة ولا زوج الرجل المم.ادم أوعودية . ولا" النسمرانية على الم 2 ٠ أراد بالصغرى في درج التسب لا في السن‎ )١ 6 وي أغالي اللداء أحمه دن كشن وعدي الله عدوي لوو الى قلق رضى الله عنه قال دزوج رجحل أمة على حرة ففرق مدر المؤمذددن رضم الله عئه. ديتهما وقال 0 دحل لك أن تترى م أهة دي حرث ١‏ ه ورواه الامير صلا م دن ابراهدم دن تاج الددن في تكميله للشفامء ٠‏ ا م سد ملل الامام ردك ب م1 مي المسلمة عل المهودية والنصرانية 4 ولاعدرة دومات دن القسم 2 وللآمة بوم
text_en:
Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) who said:

A free man may not marry a slave woman if he has a free wife, nor may a free woman marry a slave man, nor may a Muslim woman marry a Jewish or Christian man.

(He meant by "younger" in terms of lineage, not age.)

(2) And my father, may Allah be pleased with him, narrated to me from Ahmad ibn Kathir, from Abdullah ibn Wahb, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) who said: A man married a slave woman while he had a free wife, so the Commander of the Faithful (may Allah be pleased with him) separated them and said: "It is not permissible for you to marry a slave woman while you have a free wife."

(3) And the Imam Zayd ibn Ali (peace be upon him) said: A Muslim woman may not marry a Jewish or Christian man. And a free woman has two days and two nights of division (of time with her husband), and a slave woman has one day and one night.

text_ar: )0 حدثي 62 زبك سن علي عن أدمه عن سجاه جا قال : إذا زوج ارجل إبنته وهي صغيرة - ثم بلغت. ثم ذلات عليها وليس طا أن تأبى وإن كانت كبيرة فكرهت لم يازمها النكاح عن عن قال : لا يجوز النكاح على الصغار إلا بالا باء . ( حدني ( زدك عم ع) : أديه عن وده عن على ١‏ ر ضي الله عنهم ) > 03 يا ابن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم . وما الذي نسخها ؛؟ فقال رضي الله عنه: : قوله تعالى : « والذين هم لفروجهم حافظون الا على أزواجهم . أو ما ملكت ايمانذهم فاذهم غير ملومين . فمن ادتغى وراء ذلك فأولتك هم العادون » فلم يستثن الله تعالى الا الزوجة . أى ملك الدمين فقط ٠‏ كحم جعدل الا مجازا 5 كم فدح مبالغة 6 والمعنى كافته :. وهذا مدل قوله . 3 التعتيق .د رذكاة اغلة .و الاضيل ذكاة الحفية تزفاقة ...انك انا الاصل صصدما دها كاذنها الأئة ك" بخدر عن شدي ع الا دما ل صم أن بكو نك دقال : الحجر تطور غ٠‏ لأنه ل" دو صف دن لك وصماتها كأنتها صحيح ٠‏ ولا ب صيح أن يكون أذنها مبتدأ دن الاذن ل« دصلح أن بوصف ف لددد قت للادةه دون دذدا له ذييقى المعذى اذنها دل سدكوتها 5 وقدل الشرع 00
text_en:
62 - Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with him), who said: If a man marries his daughter while she is young, then she reaches puberty, and he then forces her [to remain in the marriage], she has no right to refuse. But if she was an adult and disliked it, the marriage is not binding on her. He said: Marriage is not permissible for minors except with the consent of the father.

63 - Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them), who said: O son of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), what abrogated it? He (may Allah be pleased with him) said: The saying of Allah, the Most High: "And those who guard their private parts, except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they are not to be blamed. But whoever seeks beyond that - then it is those who are the transgressors." So Allah, the Most High, did not make an exception except for the wife or what the right hand possesses only.

64 - Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them), who said: The stone is a purification, because it does not describe the purification itself, but its description is like its essence, sound. It is not correct that its permission is an initiation of permission, for permission is not suitable to be described in the absence of the matter. So the meaning remains: its permission is its silence. And the Sharia has made it so.

text_ar: 0 حدئبي )) زيك سن علي عن أبيه عن جذه عن علي ل َي الله عنهم ُُ قوول الله عر وجل : ون تستوفيعوا آنل تعداوأ دين اأنساء وأو حر صم العدل 2 ذلاك »ع ولا حظل للسراري ي ذلاثك .
text_en: Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali, may Allah be pleased with them, said: The saying of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic: "And you will never be able to be fair and just between women, even if you desire to." This refers to love, and there is no share for concubines in that.

text_ar: 0 حدثي ( زيك ان 3 عن أديه عن همه عن علي رضي الله عنعوم قال 8 درم النكاح 5 من أربسع من الحذام 0( والحنون 3 والبرص والففق . 9
text_en: Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) who said: "Flee from marriage with four types of women: the leper, the insane, the one afflicted with vitiligo, and the one with a vaginal fistula."

text_ar: ( حدثي ) زيد بسن علي عن أبيه عن بجده عن علي ( رضي الله عنهم ) أن خصيا تزواج اهرأة 0 تعلم 9 علمت 7( فكرهته فغرق ادينوها. ياب مسائل قي التهاح
text_en: Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them) reported that a eunuch married a woman, and she disliked him, so he drowned himself in a river. This is a problem regarding marriage issues.

text_ar: 2 حدثبي ) زمك سن علي عن أديه عن بجده عن علي رصي الله عاجم أن امرأة خاصمت زوجها في نفقتها فقضى للا بنصف صاع من بر لي كل يوم جد عن زيد بن علي رضي الله عنه أنه قال : لا يتزوج الرجل المسلم اليهودية والنصراذية على المسلمة » ويتزوج المسلمة على اليهودية والنصرانية | ه من المنهاج الجلي بلفظه ٠‏ (عي) وذي أمالىي أحمد ابن عيسى رضي الله عنه ما لفظه أحمد دن عيسى عن حسين بن علوان عن ابي خالد عن زيد دن على رضى الله عذه قال: اذا أسلمت المراة دعت الرجل الى الاسلام ؛ فان اسلم أقامت أن شاءت على نكاحها » وان لم تشاء كانت أملك لنفسها , واذا أسلم الرجل من أهل الكتاب دعى امراته الى الاسلام ‏ فان أجابته , والا أقام عليها | ه ٠‏ أيحف ياب الاحصان
text_en:
2 Zayd ibn Ali narrated from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, that a woman disputed with her husband concerning her maintenance, so he ruled for her half a sa' of wheat each day.

From Zayd ibn Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, he said: A Muslim man should not marry a Jewish or Christian woman in addition to a Muslim woman, but he may marry a Muslim woman in addition to a Jewish or Christian woman.

This is from Al-Minhaj Al-Jali with its wording. And in the dictations of Ahmad ibn Isa, may Allah be pleased with him, what Ahmad ibn Isa narrated from Husayn ibn Ulwan from Abu Khalid from Zayd ibn Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, he said: If a woman embraces Islam, she invites the man to Islam. If he embraces Islam, she may remain in her marriage if she wishes. If she does not wish, she has more right over herself. If a man from the People of the Book embraces Islam, he invites his wife to Islam. If she responds, [well and good], otherwise he remains married to her.

Chapter on Ihsan

text_ar: ( حدئى ) زيد بن على عن أديه عن جده عن على ( رضى الله عنهم ) قال : نمبى رسول الله ميم عن نكاح الشغار » قال : فسألت زيداً ١‏ ر صى إلله سس ( عن تفسير ذلاثك قال : هو أن كر دج الرجل داثت الرجل على أنه بزو حده زرده ولا مهوي أو احدة مذج أ :
text_en: Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them) said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) forbade *nikah ash-shighar*. I asked Zayd (may Allah be pleased with him) about its interpretation. He said: It is when a man marries off his daughter to another man on the condition that the other man marries off his daughter to him, and there is no dowry for either of them.

text_ar: 2 حدثبي ) زدك سن علي عن أبيه عن جده عن علي ( رضي الله عنم ) قال : من وطىء جاردة لأقل من تمدع ستون فهو ضاهن 5
text_en: 2 Zayd ibn Ali reported from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) who said: "Whoever has intercourse with a woman who is less than twenty years old is a guarantor."

text_ar: ) حدثي ) زيد بن علي عن أنيه عن مجده عن علي رضي الله عنهم أن رجاا تزوج اهراة قواجك42 عميوط]7؛) فكر هته 4 ففرق دمنهه ا : )١(‏ وفي آمالي الامام أحمد بن عيسى بسنده الى الامام زيد أنه قال : لا حدس الرجل بالدووونة ار +التصير انيةان والابالامة م وذ قفن واحعيق بواحدة منهن وقع عليه الحد » ولم يقع عليه الرجم اه ٠‏ (؟) الجذام كغراب علة تحدث من انتشار ' السوداء في البدن كله فيقسد مزاج الاعضاء وهياتها ع وريما انتهى الئ أكل الاعضاء وسقوطها ااه 0000 (") فرع قلت : وكذا ترد بالعفل ؛ والقرن تفريعا على الرتق والوجه قسي ذلك أنه عيب يمتع من استيفاعء الوطىع 0 فكان له رده ضه كالرتق ( والعفل ) شيع يخرج من فرج المراة كالادرة , وقيل : هى شيع مدون يخرج في الفرج ٠‏ ولا يكون في الابكار » وقيل : هى ورم في اسكتى الراة وعدى نا افروهيا « حض ل ينهد عن الكل | حا © (؟) عذيوط تصحيحه في ديوان الادب على وزن فعلول يكسر الفاء وفتح اللام قال الشاعنر : اق يليه يقانوط ليقو .كا يقتل' من اتاجاب إن كهرا 44> 1/4 ؟
text_en:
Zayd ibn Ali narrated from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them) that a man married a woman and found her to be 'afala. So he disliked her, and they were separated.

(1) In the Amali of Imam Ahmad ibn Isa, with his chain of narration to Imam Zayd, he said: "A man should not be subjected to the hadd punishment for fornication or adultery unless he has intercourse with one of them. If he has intercourse with one of them, the hadd punishment is applied to him, but not stoning."

(2) Leprosy (al-judham), like a raven, is an illness that arises from the spread of black bile throughout the entire body, corrupting the temperament of the organs and their structure. It may even lead to the eating away and falling off of limbs.

(3) A branch: I say: And similarly, she is returned due to 'afal and qarn, as a sub-issue of ratq. The reason for this is that it is a defect that prevents the consummation of intercourse, so he has the right to return her, just like ratq. ('Afal) is something that comes out of a woman's private parts, like al-adra. It is also said that it is a foul-smelling thing that comes out in the private parts. It does not occur in virgins. It is also said that it is a swelling in the woman's buttocks, and it is also said that it is a swelling in the woman's labia.

(4) 'Adhyut: Its correction in Diwan al-Adab is on the pattern of fa'lul, with a kasra on the fa and a fatha on the lam. The poet said: "He is like an 'adhyut, who kills from the Arabs if he is old."

text_ar: ) حدثي ) زديك سن علي عن أيه عن اه عن علي ( رصي الله عنهم ) قال : قلت يارسول الله إناك لتتوق 9 إلى نساء قريش »© ولا تخب بئات عملت ؟ قال : « وهل عندك شيء ؟ قلت : إبنة عماث حمزة ©) قال : إنما ابنة أخى من الرضاعة يا على » أما عاء.ت أن الله عز وجل قد شرع ف الرضاعة ها حرم من التسب في قات الله عن ول ..
text_en: Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) who said: I said, "O Messenger of Allah, we long for the women of Quraysh, but we do not desire our own women." He said, "Do you have anything?" I said, "The daughter of my paternal uncle Hamza." He said, "She is my niece through suckling, O Ali. Do you not know that Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, has legislated through suckling what He has forbidden through lineage?"

text_ar: ( حدثبي ) زيد بن علي عن أبيه عن جه عن كل راصي اليه عنم ) في رجل تزوج اءرأة فرفت إليها أنختها لوعو عا فضي الي ( رضى الله عنه ) أن للثانية مهرها بااوطىء » ولا يقرب الآولى حبى تنقضي. عدة الاخرى سج (يي) العذيوط : الذي اذا جامع تغوط في حال جماعة ٠‏ واذا كانت المرأة بهذه المثانة فهي عذيوطة قلت' : وكذا اذا وجدته بوالا عند الجماع , والوجه الخبر : ولان النفس تنضشر ممن كانت هذه حالته ,. فلم يكن فرق بدن الوجهين قلت : وكذ!ا اذا كان يضرط عند الجماع ضرطا. خارقا للعادة ء فاذه كالغائط والبوط لما قدمنا قي المسالة والفرع متها | ه ج٠‏ )١(‏ أما اذا كانت عالمة فلا فسخ , والوجه : الاجماع أي تستبري بحيضه لبعلم خلو الهم ٠”‏ بياب الرضاع )١(‏
text_en:
Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) regarding a man who married a woman, and then it was revealed to him that she was his sister through suckling. Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) ruled that the second woman should receive her dowry due to the intercourse, and he should not approach the first woman until the waiting period (iddah) of the other woman has ended.

(The term) al-ʿudhyūṭ: is one who, when he has intercourse, defecates during the act of intercourse. If the woman is in this state, she is an ʿudhyūṭah. I say: And similarly, if she finds him urinating during intercourse. The reason for this ruling is that the soul is repulsed by one whose condition is like this. So there is no difference between the two situations. I say: And similarly, if he farts during intercourse with an unusual fart, then it is like defecation and urination, as we have presented in the issue and its branch.

(1) However, if she was aware, there is no annulment. The reason for this is consensus, meaning she should observe a waiting period (istibra’) with her menstruation to ascertain the emptiness of the womb.

(Chapter on Suckling) (1)

text_ar: ( حدثي ) زيد بن عل عن أبيه عن جده عن علي ( رضي الله عنهم) في قول الله جل إسمه : والوالدات يرضعن أولادهن حولين كاملين ان أراد أن يتم الرضاعة قال : الرضاع سنتان » فا كان من رضاع في المولين حزم » وما كان بعد الحولين فلا يرم ء قال الله تعالى : وحمله وفصاله ثلاثون شهراً » فالحمل ستة (» أشهر » والرضاع (#5) والوجه في ذلك ما رويناه عنه عن أمير المؤمنين رضي الله عنه أن عمر أتي بامرأة قد حملت فوضعت حملها لستة أشهر + فهم بها عمر ثم قال : ادعوا لي عليا فقال : ما ترى في هذه المرأة ؟ قال رضي الله فخة :نوما انها فاخيرة قال هلي ان لباقي كتابا الله هدر + مخ قرا وحمله وقفصاله ثلاثون شهرا + فحمله ستة أشهر ؛ وقصاله أريع وعشرون شهرا » فكان عمر لم يقراها | هاج ٠‏ 5م" سحولان كاملان » سألت زيداً بن علي ( رضي الله عنئه ) عن اللصة والمصتين ؟ قال : حرم » وسألته ( رضي الله عنه ) عن لبن الفحل ؟ فقال ١‏ حرم » وسألته ( رضي الله عنه ) عن : رجل تزوج صبية صغيرة فأرضعتها أمه ؟ قال : ( رضى الله عنه ) قد حرمت عايه ع وءايه نصف 27 صداق الصبية » ويرجع على أمه إن كانت قد تعمدت الفساد
text_en:
Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them all), regarding the saying of Allah, glorified be His Name: "And mothers shall suckle their children for two full years, for those who wish to complete the suckling." He said: "Suckling is two years." So, whatever suckling occurs within the two years is forbidden (in marriage). And whatever occurs after the two years is not forbidden. Allah Almighty said: "And his gestation and weaning are thirty months." So, gestation is six months, and suckling is twenty-four months. The evidence for this is what we have narrated from him, from the Commander of the Believers (may Allah be pleased with him), that Umar was brought a woman who had conceived and delivered her child at six months. Umar intended to punish her, then he said: "Call Ali for me." He said: "What do you think of this woman?" Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) said: "She is not to be punished. Has Allah's Book been neglected? He recited: 'And his gestation and weaning are thirty months.' So, his gestation is six months, and his weaning is twenty-four months." It was as if Umar had not read it.

I asked Zayd ibn Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) about one suckling and two sucklings. He said: "It is forbidden." I asked him (may Allah be pleased with him) about the milk of the male. He said: "It is forbidden." I asked him (may Allah be pleased with him) about a man who married a young girl, and his mother suckled her. He (may Allah be pleased with him) said: "She is forbidden to him, and he owes her half of the girl's dowry. He can seek recourse from his mother if she intentionally caused corruption."

text_ar: ( حدثي ) زيد إن علي عن أديه عن جده عن علي ( ردي الله 8 4 المطلقة واحدة وثنتين وثلاثا »2 لا نرج مق ديتهأ ليله ولا ممأ زا 5-66 عل أجاها » والمتوف عنها زوجها ترج بالنهار » ولا تبيت في غير فرجع وقد وضعت فأتي النبى صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم فساله عن ذلك فقال صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم : قد بلغ الكتاب اجله أخطبها الئ نفسها ؟ فقال الزبير : خدعتني خدعها الله ٠‏ و مسالة ) ولا تحل من أجلها حتى تضع حملها جميعه : فان كان معها ولدان فوضعت ا الحا الو ل واه عن أمير المؤمئين رضي الله عنه أنه قال : وان كان في بطنها ولدان فولادت أحدهما ؛ فهو أحق برجعتها ما لم تلد الثاني ١ه ٠‏ لام 1 بيتها ليلا » ولا تقرس كل واحدة منهما زينة » ولا طيبا إلا أن يكون طلتها تطاليقة أو تطليقتين »© فلا يأس أن تدايسب وتزين 5
text_en:
Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) said:

"A woman divorced once, twice, or thrice, should not leave her house at night, nor should she adorn herself for anyone other than her husband. A woman whose husband has died may go out during the day, but she should not spend the night anywhere other than her home.

A woman who had given birth came to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) and asked him about this. The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The decree has reached its term. Should I propose to her myself?' Al-Zubayr said: 'You have deceived me, may Allah deceive him.'

And a ruling: She is not lawful [for marriage to another man] until she has given birth to her entire pregnancy. If she is carrying two children and gives birth to one of them, then her husband has a greater right to take her back, as long as she has not given birth to the second.

From the Commander of the Believers (may Allah be pleased with him) that he said: If she is carrying two children in her womb, and gives birth to one of them, then her husband has a greater right to take her back, as long as she has not given birth to the second.

She should not leave her house at night, and neither of them should adorn herself with ornaments or perfume, unless her divorce is a single or a double divorce. In that case, there is no harm in her adorning herself."

text_en: Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them) reported: A man came to him and said: "O Commander of the Believers, I had a wife, and I lived with her for a long time, but she did not bear children, so I divorced her. She was old and observed her `iddah in months. She thought she was among those who no longer menstruate. So I married her, and she stayed with me for thirty months, then she menstruated." So he sent for her and her husband and asked them about that. She informed him that she had observed her `iddah in months without menstruation. So he said to the latter (the second husband): "There is nothing between you and her, and the dowry is for you because you had intercourse with her." And he said to the first (husband): "She is a woman who has menstruated, and she should not marry until she completes her `iddah." He said: "What is her `iddah?" He said: "By menstruation." He said: "The woman died before her `iddah ended for the first husband, and the latter (second husband) did not inherit from her."

text_en:
I asked Zayd ibn Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) about the divorce of the Sunnah. He said: It is two types of divorce: a divorce that permits him to remarry her, even if she does not marry another husband, and a divorce that does not permit him to remarry her until she marries another husband.

As for the divorce that permits him to remarry her, it is when he divorces her while she is in a state of purity from intercourse and menstruation, and he leaves her until she menstruates three times. When she has menstruated three times, her waiting period has ended, and he is more entitled to take her back. If he divorces her during a period of purity, and then she menstruates, and then she becomes pure, he is a suitor among the suitors. If he remarries her, she is with him on two divorces.

As for the divorce that does not permit him to remarry her until she marries another husband, it is when he divorces her during a period of purity, and he is more entitled to take her back as long as the third divorce has not occurred. If he divorces her for the third time, she is not lawful for him until she marries another husband. And the waiting period for her is three menstruations.

(1) Zayd (may Allah be pleased with him) said that if the third divorce occurs, she is forbidden to her husband and is not lawful for him until she marries another husband. This is supported by what he said in Al-Jami' Al-Kafi, and its wording is: Al-Hasan and Muhammad (may Allah be pleased with them) said: If a man wishes to divorce his wife three times according to the Sunnah, and he has consummated the marriage with her, then he should divorce her during each period of purity, while she is pure from intercourse. When the third divorce occurs, she is forbidden to him, and she is not lawful for him until she marries another husband.

text_ar: وسألته ( رضى الله عنه ) عن : الرجل يتزوج المرأة على نخادم ؟ قال : لما خادم وسط » وسأاته رضي الله عنه عن : الرجلين يدعيان امرأة كل واحد منهما معه شاهدان يشهدان أنما امرأته ؟ قال : الشهادة باطلة » قلت ؛ فان وقتت إحدى الشهادتين وقتأ قبل الشهادة الأخرى. ؟ قال : هو أحق بها : وسأاته ( رضي الله عنه » عن : الربجل وامرأته عتلفان ني المهر ؟ قال : ها مهر مثلها من قومها (" , جا 00) العلال م جلك نينا "روووقد هق الف سيلى "اله هليه بزاله وس ذا تقول تق خافن كائراة وابنتها وماء رو اه كن لنى عبني اللةتعلدة وله وسلم يريد رضي الله عنه هذه الرواية » من نظر الى فوج امراة وابنتهاء فان هذا الضبر خاص ؛» وقوله صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم : « لا يحرم الحرام الحلآل عام » فيجون له أن ينكم اخته من الونا يعدى المخلوقة من ماغ أبيه من الزنا وكذلك المرأة المخلوقة من ماء حده من الزنا لا تكون عمة له فيحل نكاحها وكذلك المرأة المجلوقة من ماء جده أي أمه من الزذا 2 يحل له نكاحها ٠‏ ولا تكون خالة له عملا بالحديث لا يحرم الحرام الحلال وتفريعا على قوله رضي الله عنه في مسالة الكفاءة : أرايتم ان ولدت : يعني الحرة العربية أي للعجمي ولدا هل يثيت تسبه؟ قالوا : نعم , قلنا : هى اذا حلال , لانه لى كان حراما لم يثبت نسبه , وهد] واف كان كلاهوه ان !اليفك دق الوك لذ كيت تسديا بحل ان حلفت من ماثئة أن يذكحها لهذا الحموم » وهى الحرام لا يحرم الحلال 2 فقد خص البئت المخلوقة من ماء الرجل خسر من نظر الى قرج امراة وابنتها لم يجد رائحة الجنة ٠‏ والمراد بقومها : من كان من قبل أبيها » والوجه في ذلك أثهم القرابة على التحقيق ان هي منهم نسبا وعرقا » يوضحه أن علويا لى تكح جارية, فحصل منها ولد , فان ولدها يكون علويا اجماعا ؛ فدل أن الاب سه تك
text_en:
I asked him (may Allah be pleased with him) about a man who marries a woman for a servant. He said: "A servant is a medium [dowry]." And I asked him (may Allah be pleased with him) about two men who claim a woman, each of them having two witnesses testifying that she is his wife. He said: "The testimony is void." I said: "What if one of the testimonies was given at a time before the other testimony?" He said: "He has more right to her." And I asked him (may Allah be pleased with him) about a man and his wife disagreeing about the dowry. He said: "Her dowry is like that of her peers from her people."

And the Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "Whoever looks at the private parts of a woman and her daughter, he will not smell the scent of Paradise." And he (may Allah be pleased with him) meant by this narration: "Whoever looks at the private parts of a woman and her daughter, then this prohibition is specific." And his (peace be upon him) saying: "The unlawful does not prohibit the lawful" is general. So it is permissible for him to marry his sister from adultery, meaning the one created from his father's semen from adultery. And likewise, the woman created from his grandfather's semen from adultery is not his paternal aunt, so it is permissible to marry her. And likewise, the woman created from his grandfather's semen, meaning his mother's, from adultery, it is permissible for him to marry her. And she is not his maternal aunt, acting upon the hadith "The unlawful does not prohibit the lawful." And branching from his (may Allah be pleased with him) saying regarding the issue of compatibility: "Do you not see that if she gave birth," meaning the free Arab woman to the non-Arab, "a child, would his lineage be established?" They said: "Yes." We said: "Then she is lawful, because if it were unlawful, his lineage would not be established." And this is if it was as they said, that the unlawful does not prohibit the lawful. So he specified the girl created from the man's semen. "Whoever looks at the private parts of a woman and her daughter will not smell the scent of Paradise." And what is meant by "her people" is those from her father's side. And the reason for that is that they are the relatives in reality if she is from them by lineage and origin. This is clarified by the fact that if an Alawi marries a slave girl, and a child results from her, then her child is Alawi by consensus. This indicates that the father is the source.

text_ar: 2 حدثي ) زيد بن علي عن أديه عن جده عن علي ( رضي ألله عنهم) قال : الأقراء : الحيض () )١(‏ قال الامام المهدي محمد بن المطهر رضي الله عنه في كتايه عقود العقران بعد ان ذكر ما قيل في القرء ..ن الاختلاف ما لفظه : والحق عندي أن القره : يطلق على الحرض والطهر لفة الا أن المراد به في الشرع الحيضى ؛ والوجه في ذلك ها رويتاه عن التبي صلى الله عليه وآله وسله انه قال : [لتي سساأاته وهي مستحاضة دعى الصلاة أيام أقرائكك التي كنت تحيضين فيهن + وأيضا فان النبي صلى الله عليه وآلمه وسلم قال « طلاق الامة تطلءقتان . وعدتها حيضتان » وهذا نص في موضع النزا ع 1ه ٠‏ كلك #.ؤكذا ذولهتوشئي اللاعنة فى" الففاس وقد سال أن كال هيه اال كم تجلس النفساء ؟ فقال : ذلاثة قروء كما تقدم ٠‏ ملم >

2 Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them) said: "Al-Aqra' (plural of Qur') are the menses."

The Imam al-Mahdi Muhammad ibn al-Mutahhar (may Allah be pleased with him) said in his book *Uqud al-Aqran*, after mentioning what was said about al-Qur': "...The truth, in my opinion, is that al-Qur' linguistically applies to both menstruation and purity. However, what is intended by it in the Shari'ah is menstruation. The reason for this is what we have narrated from the Prophet (peace be upon him) that he said to a woman who was suffering from irregular bleeding: 'Leave salah during the days of your menses (aqra'ik) in which you used to menstruate.' Also, the Prophet (peace be upon him) said: 'The divorce of a female slave is two divorces, and her waiting period is two menstruations.' This is a clear text in the matter of dispute."

Similarly, his (Ali's) saying in *Al-Fawa'id*, when he was asked: "How long does a woman in postpartum bleeding (nifas) stay?" He replied: "Three menses (quru'), as mentioned previously."

text_ar: ( حدثبي ) زيد بن علي عن أبيه عن جده عن علي ( رضي الله عنهم) أن رجلا مان قريش طلق امرأته هائة تطاللميقة (2 فأسخخير بذلاث النبي علخو فقال : بانت منه بثلاث » وسبع وتسعون معصية في عتقه . « حدثي » زيد بن علي عن أديه عن جده عن علي ( راضي الله عنهم) قال * لعن راسوال الله ار المحلل والمحكل له 1
text_en:
Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them) said: A man from Quraysh divorced his wife one hundred divorces. This was mentioned to the Prophet (peace be upon him), and he said: "She is irrevocably divorced from him by three, and ninety-seven are a sin on his neck."

Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them) said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) cursed the one who makes a woman lawful (for her former husband) and the one for whom she is made lawful.

text_en: Zayd ibn Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, narrated from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali, may Allah be pleased with them, that he would give the impotent man a year's grace. If he was able to consummate the marriage, then good, otherwise, he would separate them.

text_ar: ( حدثي ) زيد بن علي عن أبيه عن جده عن علي ( رضي الله عنهم ) في : الرجل يلاق امرأته طلاقاً بائناً ؟ قال : ليس له أن يتروج : أختها حتى ينقضي أجلها . وني الرجل يكون له أربع نسوة فيطلق 8 00 إحد اهن طلاوا بائئاً . قال : ليس له أن زوج تجا مسة حى تنغضى عادة_ المطامة منهن )١(‏ والفرق بين أنت طالق ٠»‏ وطالق ٠+‏ وطالق ٠‏ وبين قوله طالق ثلادًا : أن قوله : أنت طالق في التي لم يدخل بها تطليقة بان فقوله وطالق.وطالق ايقاع للطلاق علىمن لا يملك عقدة نكاحها لبينونتها منهيخلاف قولهأنت طالق ثلاثا . فانها لم تطلق الا بمجموع اللفظ والتقليد هنا معتبر , فان كانت مدخولا بها طلقت ثلاثا » وان لم تكن مدخولا يها + فكذلك | اه أم 9
text_en:
Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them) said concerning a man who divorces his wife with an irrevocable divorce: He is not permitted to marry her sister until her waiting period has ended. And concerning a man who has four wives and divorces one of them with an irrevocable divorce: He is not permitted to marry a fifth wife until the waiting period of the divorced wife among them has ended.

The difference between "You are divorced," "and divorced," "and divorced," and his saying "You are divorced three times" is that his saying "You are divorced" to a woman with whom he has not consummated the marriage is a single irrevocable divorce. So his saying "and divorced, and divorced" is the pronouncement of divorce upon one whose marriage bond he does not possess due to her irrevocability from him. This is in contrast to his saying "You are divorced three times," for she is not divorced except by the combination of the words, and the intention here is considered. If the marriage has been consummated, she is divorced three times. If the marriage has not been consummated, then it is likewise.

text_ar: ( سألت ) زيدآً بن علي ( رضي الله عنه ) عن رجل قال 5-0 فلانة فهى طالق ؟ قال: أكرهه ورليست بحرام : ( وسألته ) « رضي الله عبد عي الاق لقان د حدثني , أني عن أبيه عن علي ( رضي الله عنهم ) أنه قال : ثلاث نحط أ من وعمدهن )010 وهزضهن » وبحدهن سواء الطلاق : والعتاق » والتكتاح : ( وسألته ) ( رضي الله عنه ) عن الطلاق بالفارسية والقرطية ؟ قال : : الطلاق بكل لسان 3 ١‏ وسأاته ) عن : الرجل يعالق في نفسه » ولا يتكلم بلسانه ؟ قال : لا تطلق » ( وسألته ) ( رضي الله عنه ) عن : الرجل إن قال لامرأته أنت طااق إن شاء الله : أو قال لعبده : اتعوسصر إن شاع اش ؟ قال :لذ تلق 0" لفراكة ول عق عمد ف قال : وسأاته ( رضي اسيم ) عن 050 قال لامراته ا طالق ١‏ وطالق » وطالق © قال : إن كان دشحل بها فثلاث »2 وإن لم يدخل ' )١(‏ ان قيل ؛ وما في هذا الخبسر من دلالة على وقوع طلاق 'المكره » وهى اكت ل ا اي 0 عليه لا ذية أبي الحسين رضي الله عنه أنه ما حلف يمينأ قط الا استكثنى قفيها فقال: ان شاء الله تعالى كان ذلك في رضى » أو غضب وقال رضي الله عنه الاستثناء من كل شىيء جائن ٠‏ )4 يعنى بائن لان من طلق التي لم يدخل بها مرة بانت منه ا ها ام ٠‏ با قاد 100 رون قال 11 انك ظالق 6زنا .جني الاك تا عات دخل بها أم لم يدخل . ياب الخلع
text_en: I asked Zayd ibn Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) about a man who said, "So-and-so is divorced." He said, "I dislike it, but it is not unlawful." And I asked him (may Allah be pleased with him) about the Prophet (peace be upon him) who narrated to me, from his father, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them) that he said: "Three things, whether done seriously or in jest, are binding: divorce, emancipation, and marriage." And I asked him (may Allah be pleased with him) about divorce in Persian and Coptic. He said: "Divorce is valid in any language." And I asked him about a man who divorces in his heart but does not speak with his tongue. He said: "She is not divorced." And I asked him (may Allah be pleased with him) about a man who says to his wife, "You are divorced, if Allah wills," or says to his slave, "You are free, if Allah wills." He said: "She is not divorced, and he is not freed." And I asked him (may Allah be pleased with him) about a man who says to his wife, "You are divorced, and divorced, and divorced." He said: "If he has consummated the marriage with her, then it is three divorces. If he has not consummated the marriage with her, then it is one divorce." (1) If it is said: "What is the indication in this report for the validity of the divorce of one who is coerced?" And it is said that Abu al-Husayn (may Allah be pleased with him) never swore an oath except that he made an exception in it, saying, "If Allah wills," whether in pleasure or in anger. And he (may Allah be pleased with him) said: "An exception is permissible in everything." (2) Meaning, it is an irrevocable divorce, because whoever divorces a woman with whom he has not consummated the marriage once, she becomes irrevocably divorced from him. (3) This is the opinion of those who say that if he says to her, "You are divorced," it is one divorce, whether he has consummated the marriage with her or not. Chapter on Khul' (divorce by mutual consent).

text_ar: حدتى » زيد بن عل عن أبيه عن جده عن علي ( رضي الله عنهم) ما نويت ٠‏ فإن قال : نويت وأحدة : كانت واحدة بائناً » وهى )١(‏ فتعتد بعد التفريق باقي عدتها من الاول ثم تستقبل عدة كاملة من الثاني أ ه منهاج بالمغفتي.-؟ (؟) قال الامام محمد بن المطهر رضي الله عنه في المنهاج وعنه يعنى عن الامام زيد بن علي رضي الله عنه انه قال : جاء رجلان من قريش الى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم فقالا : ان ابانا طلق امنا مائة تطليقة فقال رضي الله عنه : أن أباكما عصى ربه فلم يجعل له فرجا بانت امكما من أبيكما بثلاث وسبع وتسعون معصية ١‏ ه منهاج ٠‏ يقال : في كنايات الطلاق هي خلية ! ه مصباح وفيه ما لفظه بته بنا 4ه أمللك بنفسها » وإن قال : نويت ثلاثاً كانت حراماً حبى تنكس زوجاً غيره » ولا تحل لاذول حتى تدعمل 7(" بالثاني ويذوق من عسياتها وتذوق عن عسياته )م حلي ) زيل سن علي عن أديه عن جله (ر ضي الله عنهم ) ف الرجل يقول لامرأته اعتدى . قال: إن كان لم يدخل ا بانت . لأا لا عدة عليها » وإن كان قد دخل ما فهي واحدة علاك با الرجعة .
text_en: Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them): What did you intend? If he said: "I intended one," it was one irrevocable divorce. And she (1) then observes the remainder of her waiting period from the first (husband) after the separation, then she begins a full waiting period from the second. End of Minhaaj bil-Mughni. (2) Imam Muhammad ibn al-Mutahhar (may Allah be pleased with him) said in al-Minhaaj, and from him, meaning from Imam Zayd ibn Ali (may Allah be pleased with him), that he said: Two men from Quraysh came to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and said: "Our father divorced our mother a hundred divorces." He (may Allah be pleased with him) said: "Your father disobeyed his Lord, so He did not make a way out for him. Your mother is irrevocably divorced from your father with three (divorces), and ninety-seven are a sin." End of Minhaaj. It is said: Regarding the allusions of divorce, "You are free!" End of Misbah. And in it is the wording: "You are irrevocably divorced from me," "You own yourself." And if he said: "I intended three," she was forbidden until she marries another husband. And she is not lawful for the first until she has intercourse (3) with the second and he tastes of her sweetness and she tastes of his sweetness. (4) Ali, from Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather (may Allah be pleased with them): Regarding a man who says to his wife: "Observe your waiting period." He said: If he had not consummated the marriage with her, she is irrevocably divorced, because there is no waiting period for her. And if he had consummated the marriage, then it is one (divorce) and he has the right to take her back.

text_ar: ( حدثبي ) زيد بن علي عن أبيه عن جده عن علي ١‏ رضي الله عنهم ) قال : قال رسول الله عله : « الثيب ') بالثيب » جلد مائثة : واأرجم الك تالكر جلو ماتة وبين امة 9ن
text_en: Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: "The married man with the married woman: one hundred lashes and stoning. And the unmarried man with the unmarried woman: one hundred lashes and banishment for a year."

text_en: Zayd ibn Ali reported from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) that a woman came to him and confessed to adultery. He sent her back until she did that four times. Then he left her until she gave birth to her child. When she gave birth, he did not stone her until he found someone to guarantee her child. Then he commanded her to be flogged, then he commanded her to be stoned. Then he commanded the people to stone her. Then he said: "If the Imam carries out the stoning based on a confession, the Imam stones her, then the people stone her. If the Imam carries out the stoning based on witnesses, the witnesses stone her, then the Imam stones her, then the Muslims stone her." Then he said: "Her flogging was for the right of Allah, and her stoning was for the right of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him."

text_ar: ( حدثبي ار علي عن أديه عن جده عن علي ) واي الله عنهوم ) أن أهة أبقت إلى اليمين » ذ:ةتزوجها رجل فأو ادها أولاداً ع م إن سيدها اعثر فها داابينة العادلة فقال : بأخذها سيدها وأولادها أحرار » وعلى أبيهم قيمتهم على قدر أسنائهم صغار فصغار » وكبار فكبار © ويرجع فل الذي غوف 1107 حيها 01 فان لم يغره آحد رجع على الامة : فاذا عتقت طامبها بذلك ٠‏ ولا شيع على سيدها | ه ام فان كانت هي التي دلست عليه بأنها حرة وجب على سيدها تسليمها الى أبي الاولاد بجنايتها ٠‏ لان تدليسها جناية والجذاية تتعلق برقبتها » فان سلمها سيدها بجنايتها فله قيمة أولادها , والا فما زاد على قيمتها ان اخحثار امساكها ٠‏ (يده) قال في الجامع الكافي : مسألة عدة الرجل قال محمد رضي الله عنه يجب على الرجل العدة من أربعة أوجه اذا طلق امرأته فلا يتزوج أختها حتى تنقضي عدة المطلقة , واذا كانت له أريع نسوة فطلقاحداهن فلا يتزو جح خامسة حتىتنتقضي عدة المطلقة.ءوان! كانت له أربعنسوة فارتدت احداهن عن الاسلام » ولحقت بدار الكفر » فلا يتزوج حتى تذقضصي عدة >>
chapter: باب الامة يتزوجها الرجل على انها حرة
text_en:
(Narrated to me by Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali) may Allah be pleased with them, that a slave woman fled to Yemen. A man married her and she bore him children. Then her master found her and brought forth clear evidence. So he said: Her master takes her, and her children are free. And their father owes their value according to their ages, young for young, and old for old. And he may return to the one who deceived him about her freedom. If no one deceived him, he may return to the slave woman. When she is freed, he may demand it from her. And there is nothing upon her master. If she was the one who deceived him by claiming to be free, then her master must hand her over to the father of the children due to her transgression. Because her deception is a transgression, and the transgression is attached to her neck. If her master hands her over due to her transgression, then he gets the value of her children. Otherwise, he gets what exceeds her value if he chooses to keep her.

(In his hand) He said in Al-Jami' Al-Kafi: A matter of a man's waiting period. Muhammad, may Allah be pleased with him, said: A man must observe a waiting period in four situations: If he divorces his wife, he may not marry her sister until the divorced woman's waiting period ends. If he has four wives and divorces one of them, he may not marry a fifth until the divorced woman's waiting period ends. If he has four wives and one of them apostatizes from Islam and joins the land of disbelief, he may not marry until her waiting period ends.
